description_en: Use SubmitCopyrightJob to submit a video copyright watermark job
description_zh: 调用SubmitCopyrightJob提交视频版权水印任务
name: SubmitCopyrightJob

parameters.help_en:
The location of the input media object in OSS, specified as a JSON object. Currently, only video files are supported. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

The OSS bucket must be in the same region as MPS.

`Bucket`: The name of the input OSS bucket.

`Location`: The region of the OSS bucket. This must be the same as the MPS region.

`Object`: The object in the OSS bucket to be processed
parameters.help_zh:
待添加水印的媒体文件OSS地址，目前仅支持视频文件，JSON对象。详细信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。

OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致。
  
Bucket：输入文件OSS Bucket名称。
Location：OSS所在地域，必须和MPS服务所在地域一致。
Object：待检测OSS Object
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en:
The location of the output object in OSS, specified as a JSON object.

The OSS bucket must be in the same region as MPS
parameters.help_zh:
文件输出OSS地址，JSON对象。

OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: output

parameters.help_en: The start time for embedding the watermark, in seconds. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 水印嵌入开始时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为0
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The total duration for embedding the watermark, in seconds. If unspecified, the watermark is applied to the entire video
parameters.help_zh: 水印嵌入总时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为视频时长
parameters.name: total_time

parameters.help_en: The watermark embedding channel. Valid values: 0 (U channel), 1 (UV channels), and 2 (YUV channels)
parameters.help_zh: 水印级别，取值0/1/2，表示嵌入通道，0u，1uv，2yuv
parameters.name: level

parameters.example: Address: Shangke Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
parameters.help_en: A description of the watermark information
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The callback URL for job results. Only HTTP URLs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 任务结果回调URL，目前仅支持HTTP地址
parameters.name: call_back

parameters.help_en: A publicly accessible URL of the video. If specified, this URL is used as the job input and overrides the `Input` parameter
parameters.help_zh: 可公网访问的视频URL链接。填写后优先将其作为任务输入，其次再考虑Input输入
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: User-defined data. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
Additional parameters for the watermarking job, specified as a JSON string. The following parameter is supported:

`algoType`: The algorithm type. Default value: `v1`.

`v1`: The copyright watermark algorithm for long-form video. It supports only videos that are 3 minutes or longer.

`v2`: The copyright watermark algorithm for short-form video
parameters.help_zh:
水印任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

algoType：算法类型，默认值为v1。
v1：长视频版权水印，仅支持3min以上的。
v2：短视频版权水印
parameters.name: params
